gallery_info.name: vGallerySpace
gallery_info.creator: FRAMOUS
gallery_info.philosophy: vGallerySpace presents pure, tracker-free architectural exhibitions treated with the reverence of a physical institution.

exhibitions.title: Future, Current, and Past Vision
exhibitions.summary: vGallerySpace presents exhibitions across three temporal planes: Future (speculative digital architecture), Current (active exhibitions like codes.gallery), and Past (archival records spanning 1984–2014).

exhibitions.title: Curation Philosophy
exhibitions.summary: vGallerySpace presents pure, tracker-free architectural exhibitions treated with the reverence of a physical institution.

exhibitions.title: codes.gallery
exhibitions.summary: codes.gallery is our featured exhibition examining agentic AI collaboration, generative code as creative material, and solo structuring across nearly two years of intensive development.

exhibitions.title: Prototype No. 7
exhibitions.summary: Featured in the STUDIO, Prototype No. 7 is an unfinished carbon fiber coffee table exploring movable, transformable architecture under the arch>scul prototypes series.

exhibitions.title: arch>scul prototypes
exhibitions.summary: The arch>scul prototypes series examines the intersection of architecture and sculpture, exploring structural, transformable spatial forms.

exhibitions.title: Infinity Museum : XTZ
exhibitions.summary: Infinity Museum : XTZ explores infinite spatial curation and crypto-art archives on Tezos.

exhibitions.title: Auto-Mnemonic Body
exhibitions.summary: Auto-Mnemonic Body examines digital memory, physical form, and self-archival systems.

exhibitions.title: Ad Art Show (2020 / 2021)
exhibitions.summary: Featured at the Oculus in Westfield World Trade Center, NYC, bridging commercial advertising design and fine art.

exhibitions.title: OFFICE Archives & Way Back Machine
exhibitions.summary: The OFFICE houses Way Back Machine archives, Facebook records, and reflections documenting nearly three decades of studio evolution (1984–2014).

exhibitions.title: Acquisitions & Storefronts
exhibitions.summary: You can acquire physical works, rare collectibles, and digital editions via Artsy, eBay, OpenSea, and Objkt in the top-right cart dropdown.

exhibitions.title: FAQ & Direct Contact with FRAMOUS
exhibitions.summary: For direct questions, acquisitions, studio visits, or press inquiries, you can reach FRAMOUS directly at framous@vgallery.space, join the Guest List at /guest-list.html, or browse active listings on Artsy, eBay (vgalleryspace), and OpenSea.

artist.name: FRAMOUS
artist.summary: vGallerySpace was created by FRAMOUS, an artist and designer spanning architectural sculpture, brand direction, advertising, and digital/AI curation over three decades.
